question: During rubbing, a woollen cloth receives $1.5 \times 10^{10}$ electrons from a plastic rod. Calculate the charge acquired by the cloth and state the sign of charge left on the rod. Take $e = 1.6 \times 10^{-19}\text{ C}$.

options.A:
Cloth: $+2.4 \times 10^{-9}\text{ C}$
Rod: negative charge of equal magnitude
options.B:
Cloth: $-1.5 \times 10^{-9}\text{ C}$
Rod: positive charge of equal magnitude
options.C:
Cloth: $-2.4 \times 10^{-10}\text{ C}$
Rod: positive charge of equal magnitude
options.D:
Cloth: $-2.4 \times 10^{-9}\text{ C}$
Rod: positive charge of equal magnitude
